subfiles.about: A cross-reference sheet indexing a despatch from Ambassador Grew concerning the public trials and court-martials of the 1932 political assassins.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's despatch No. 490 on trials of the 1932 assassins.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch No. 490 on Trials of Assassins

subfiles.about: A report excerpt discussing the ongoing trials and background of civilian, military, and naval perpetrators of the 1932 assassinations in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Report extract on the trials of civilians, naval officers and army cadets for the 1932 assassinations, plotted by young rural men.
subfiles.title: Report Extract on the Trials of Civilian, Military and Naval Assassins

subfiles.about: A State Department memorandum discussing a Japanese statute scheduled for April 1936 that would debar foreign attorneys from practicing law in Japan.
subfiles.summary: FE memo: Japan's lawyers' law of April 1936 will bar the three American lawyers in Japan, absent reciprocity; no formal protest is warranted.
subfiles.title: Memorandum on Japanese Lawyers' Law and Debarment of Foreign Lawyers
